description: Build exemption_expirer.py — nightly check for mcp_exemptions rows past valid_until. Read from mcp_exemptions WHERE valid_until < CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'active'. Update status to 'expired'. Write one audit_log row per expiry. Pure daemon pattern: run() + if __name__ == '__main__': run(). No DB writes except via write_service. Heartbeat to service_health. Spec-listed in Appendix A as NOT YET BUILT.
